_help: Bombette (PM64) on c_pinky, part by part: every PM64 sprite row's frames, tick for tick (step keys at each sprite change), measured from the sprite's own frames and put on the model's parts as moves from the sprite's Still frame (one sprite pixel = 9/22 model unit, the ball's width). Rows: F<n> the field sprite's (WorldBombette) animation n, B<n> the battle sprite's (BattleBombette). Our numbers only. Notes: local-docs/poses/bombette.md.
